{{Top|leg}}
A '''subsonic scanner''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] designed to detect underwater movement. The [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] [[Jio Gihal]] used a subsonic scanner to track [[Chiilak/Legends|chiilaks]] on [[Misnor]].<ref name= "CG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
